positions.label: Obstacle
positions.prompt_hint: what is in the way, or what the pull is against

positions.label: Advice
positions.prompt_hint: where this could land, and what to do with it

cards.name: The Fool
cards.imagery_line: A young man steps toward a cliff edge with a rose in one hand and a bundle on a stick, a small dog at his heels.

meanings.situation: standing at the start of something, not yet committed
meanings.obstacle: leaping before looking, or refusing to leap at all
meanings.advice: let it be unfinished; take the first step without the whole plan
meanings.general: beginnings, innocence, stepping out without a map

cards.name: The Magician
cards.imagery_line: A figure stands at a table of cup, sword, coin and wand, one arm raised to the sky and the other pointing at the ground.

meanings.situation: the means are already available, whether or not they are being used
meanings.obstacle: capability without direction; talking about it instead of doing it
meanings.advice: name what you actually want, then use what is already in reach
meanings.general: will, focus, having the tools already in hand

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.imagery_line: A veiled woman sits between a black pillar and a white one, a half-hidden scroll in her lap, a crescent moon at her feet.

meanings.situation: something known but unspoken, still under the surface
meanings.obstacle: an answer being withheld, including from yourself
meanings.advice: stop explaining and listen for what you already suspect
meanings.general: inner knowing, what has not been said aloud

cards.name: The Empress
cards.imagery_line: A woman rests on cushions in a field of ripe wheat, a crown of stars on her head, a stream running behind her.

meanings.situation: something being tended and slowly filling out
meanings.obstacle: over-tending, or giving where nothing comes back
meanings.advice: let it grow at its own pace; feed it rather than force it
meanings.general: abundance, nurture, things growing on their own time

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.imagery_line: A crowned figure sits upright on a stone throne carved with rams' heads, bare mountains behind him.

meanings.situation: order holding things together, whether chosen or inherited
meanings.obstacle: rigidity, or someone else's rules standing in the way
meanings.advice: decide what the frame is, and hold it without apologising
meanings.general: structure, authority, boundaries

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.imagery_line: A robed teacher raises one hand between two pillars while two figures kneel before him, crossed keys at his feet.

meanings.situation: operating inside an established system
meanings.obstacle: inherited rules that no longer fit the person following them
meanings.advice: keep the teacher or the tradition worth keeping; discard the rest
meanings.general: tradition, teaching, the accepted way of doing things

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.imagery_line: A man and a woman stand apart beneath a winged figure in the sun, a tree behind each of them.

meanings.situation: two things pulling, or a bond that defines the ground
meanings.obstacle: a choice deferred; wanting both paths at once
meanings.advice: choose by what you value, not by which is easier to explain
meanings.general: choice, union, what you align yourself with

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.imagery_line: An armoured figure rides a chariot drawn by one black sphinx and one white, holding no reins.

meanings.situation: movement underway, powered by tension held in balance
meanings.obstacle: force applied without steering; speed used as avoidance
meanings.advice: keep the two halves pulling the same way and stay on the road
meanings.general: drive, momentum, opposing forces held together

cards.name: Strength
cards.imagery_line: A woman in white lays her hands on a lion's jaws without hurry, a chain of flowers at her waist.

meanings.situation: something wild being handled gently rather than fought
meanings.obstacle: trying to overpower what only yields to patience
meanings.advice: meet it softly and repeatedly; force will cost more than it wins
meanings.general: steady courage, patience over force

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.imagery_line: An old man stands alone on a summit holding up a lantern with a star inside it.

meanings.situation: a deliberate step back from the noise
meanings.obstacle: isolation dressed up as reflection
meanings.advice: take the solitude you need, then bring the lantern back down
meanings.general: withdrawal, searching alone, the light carried inward

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.imagery_line: A great wheel turns in the sky, a sphinx above it, a serpent sliding down one side and a figure rising on the other.

meanings.situation: a phase turning over; timing doing much of the work
meanings.obstacle: waiting on luck, or fighting a cycle that has to run
meanings.advice: act on the part that is yours and let the rest turn
meanings.general: turning, cycles, what sits outside your control

cards.name: Justice
cards.imagery_line: A crowned figure sits between two pillars, an upright sword in one hand and a set of scales in the other.

meanings.situation: a reckoning in progress; cause and effect coming due
meanings.obstacle: an imbalance nobody has named out loud
meanings.advice: weigh it honestly, your own part included, then decide
meanings.general: balance, consequence, honest accounting

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.imagery_line: A man hangs upside down from a wooden beam by one ankle, his other leg crossed, a light around his head.

meanings.situation: a pause that cannot be rushed; things upside down
meanings.obstacle: stuckness mistaken for patience; waiting used as a strategy
meanings.advice: stop struggling long enough for the view to change
meanings.general: suspension, reversal, seeing from another angle

cards.name: Death
cards.imagery_line: A skeleton in armour rides a white horse past a fallen king, a bishop and a child, the sun rising between two towers.

meanings.situation: something is ending, whether or not it has been admitted
meanings.obstacle: holding on to what is already over
meanings.advice: let the ending finish; what comes next needs the room
meanings.general: endings, transformation, what has to be let go

cards.name: Temperance
cards.imagery_line: A winged figure pours water between two cups, one foot on the bank and one in the stream.

meanings.situation: two things being mixed into something workable
meanings.obstacle: extremes swinging back and forth instead of settling
meanings.advice: adjust in small amounts and keep testing the mix
meanings.general: blending, moderation, patient adjustment

cards.name: The Devil
cards.imagery_line: A horned figure crouches above a man and a woman, the chains around their necks hanging loose.

meanings.situation: a pattern with a hold on things, familiar and comfortable
meanings.obstacle: a dependence being called a preference
meanings.advice: name what you get out of it; the chain is looser than it looks
meanings.general: attachment, compulsion, chains that are looser than they look

cards.name: The Tower
cards.imagery_line: Lightning strikes the crown off a tower and two figures fall from it into the dark.

meanings.situation: something breaking down fast, and not by choice
meanings.obstacle: defending a structure that is already failing
meanings.advice: let it fall and find out what was actually load-bearing
meanings.general: sudden collapse, a structure that could not hold

cards.name: The Star
cards.imagery_line: A woman kneels at the water's edge pouring from two pitchers, one large star and seven small ones above her.

meanings.situation: a calm opening after something hard
meanings.obstacle: hope so faint it is easier to ignore than to hold
meanings.advice: keep pouring; the small steady acts are the repair
meanings.general: hope, clarity after the storm, quiet repair

cards.name: The Moon
cards.imagery_line: A dog and a wolf howl at the moon while a crayfish crawls from the pool, a path running between two towers.

meanings.situation: half-lit ground; instinct running ahead of the facts
meanings.obstacle: fear and imagination filling in what isn't known
meanings.advice: walk the path in poor light rather than waiting for noon
meanings.general: uncertainty, dreams, what is unclear by nature

cards.name: The Sun
cards.imagery_line: A child rides a white horse under a large sun, a red banner in hand, sunflowers along the wall behind.

meanings.situation: things out in the open, simpler than expected
meanings.obstacle: exposure that feels like too much light
meanings.advice: say the plain version out loud and let it be that simple
meanings.general: clarity, warmth, being seen plainly

cards.name: Judgement
cards.imagery_line: An angel sounds a trumpet above the water and figures rise from open coffins with their arms lifted.

meanings.situation: a summing up; the past asking for a verdict
meanings.obstacle: a call heard clearly and left unanswered
meanings.advice: decide what the story actually was, then answer it
meanings.general: reckoning, awakening, answering a call

cards.name: The World
cards.imagery_line: A figure dances inside a great wreath with a wand in each hand, a winged creature in each corner.

meanings.situation: something arriving at its full shape
meanings.obstacle: finishing avoided; a loop left open on purpose
meanings.advice: close it properly, and let an ending be an ending
meanings.general: completion, wholeness, a cycle closing

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A hand offers a cup from a cloud, water spilling over in five streams, a dove descending toward it.

meanings.situation: something new offered on the feeling side, not yet taken up
meanings.obstacle: an offer that is hard to accept or to trust
meanings.advice: accept what is being offered before you analyse it
meanings.general: feeling offered, a new opening on the heart's side

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A man and a woman face each other and raise their cups, a winged lion's head above them.

meanings.situation: a real exchange between two people
meanings.obstacle: a bond that needs both hands, and only one is offered
meanings.advice: make the exchange explicit: say what you are giving and what you want
meanings.general: meeting, mutual regard, a bond formed between equals

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.imagery_line: Three women lift their cups together in a circle, fruit at their feet.

meanings.situation: a circle of people holding things up right now
meanings.obstacle: company that crowds out the harder conversation
meanings.advice: tell the people around you; let it be witnessed
meanings.general: shared joy, company, celebration

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A young man sits under a tree with his arms folded, three cups in front of him and a fourth offered from a cloud.

meanings.situation: enough on the table, and none of it landing
meanings.obstacle: an offer refused because it is not the expected one
meanings.advice: look up; something is being held out that you haven't counted
meanings.general: discontent, offers unseen, boredom with enough

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A cloaked figure looks down at three spilled cups and does not turn to see the two still standing.

meanings.situation: attention held by what was lost
meanings.obstacle: grief that hides what is still standing
meanings.advice: count what is left before you leave the field
meanings.general: loss, grief, attention fixed on what spilled

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A child hands another a cup filled with flowers in a quiet courtyard.

meanings.situation: the past present in the room, warmly or otherwise
meanings.obstacle: nostalgia used as a place to live
meanings.advice: take the good from the old thing and carry it forward
meanings.general: memory, kindness, the past returning gently

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A figure faces seven cups rising in cloud, each holding something different and some of it strange.

meanings.situation: many possibilities, unequal in substance
meanings.obstacle: too many appealing options and no test to sort them
meanings.advice: pick the one you would still want if nobody saw it
meanings.general: options, fantasy, choices that are not all real

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A figure walks away toward the mountains, leaving eight cups stacked behind, under a clouded moon.

meanings.situation: a departure underway from something that mostly worked
meanings.obstacle: staying out of investment rather than out of desire
meanings.advice: leave properly; a partial exit costs more than a clean one
meanings.general: leaving, walking away from what is nearly enough

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A man sits with his arms folded in front of nine cups arranged on a curved bench behind him.

meanings.situation: wishes met, at least on the surface
meanings.obstacle: contentment that has stopped asking for anything
meanings.advice: enjoy it plainly, and check that the wish was the real one
meanings.general: satisfaction, comfort, having what you asked for

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A couple raise their arms toward a rainbow of ten cups while two children dance beside them.

meanings.situation: something whole and shared, at least for now
meanings.obstacle: an ideal picture that the real one keeps failing
meanings.advice: measure it against your life, not against the picture
meanings.general: belonging, shared happiness, home

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A young figure holds up a cup with a fish looking out of it, the sea moving behind.

meanings.situation: something small and new surfacing, still odd
meanings.obstacle: a feeling too new to be taken seriously yet
meanings.advice: follow the odd small impulse and find out what it is
meanings.general: a new feeling, curiosity, an unexpected message

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A rider moves at a walk, holding a cup out in front of him, a stream crossing his path.

meanings.situation: movement led by feeling rather than by plan
meanings.obstacle: a pursuit that stalls whenever the mood does
meanings.advice: make the offer, and carry it the whole way
meanings.general: following feeling, an offer carried to someone

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A queen sits at the water's edge holding an ornate covered cup and looking straight into it.

meanings.situation: feeling being held and considered rather than acted on
meanings.obstacle: absorbing other people's feelings until your own go unclear
meanings.advice: trust what you feel, and say it as information
meanings.general: deep feeling held steadily, intuition, care

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.imagery_line: A king holds a cup on a throne that floats on moving water, a ship behind him.

meanings.situation: strong currents handled calmly from the surface
meanings.obstacle: calm maintained by keeping the depth out of view
meanings.advice: stay steady without pretending the water is still
meanings.general: emotional steadiness, deep water handled calmly

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A hand offers a single coin above a garden, an arched gate opening onto the mountains.

meanings.situation: a concrete opportunity present, not yet picked up
meanings.obstacle: a solid option that would mean actually starting
meanings.advice: take the practical opening and make it real this week
meanings.general: a material opening, an offer with substance to it

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A figure juggles two coins tied by a looping ribbon while ships ride high waves behind.

meanings.situation: several things being kept up at once
meanings.obstacle: keeping everything moving so that nothing has to be chosen
meanings.advice: keep only what you can hold while the water is rough
meanings.general: juggling, balance in motion, competing demands

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A stonemason works in a church while two others stand with the plans and watch.

meanings.situation: work underway with others, roles in place
meanings.obstacle: skill without agreement about what is being built
meanings.advice: say what you are good at and let others hold their part
meanings.general: craft, collaboration, work being built to a plan

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A seated figure grips one coin to his chest, one balanced on his head and one under each foot.

meanings.situation: something being gripped tightly and kept safe
meanings.obstacle: security held so tightly it prevents movement
meanings.advice: loosen one hand and find out what the grip is protecting
meanings.general: holding on, security, control of what you have

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: Two figures pass through snow beneath a lit window, one on crutches, neither looking up.

meanings.situation: a lean stretch, and the feeling of being outside it alone
meanings.obstacle: help close by and never asked for
meanings.advice: ask; the door you keep walking past is open
meanings.general: hardship, exclusion, being outside the warm room

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A man holds a set of scales in one hand and drops coins into the hands of two kneeling figures.

meanings.situation: help moving in one direction, and measured
meanings.obstacle: generosity that keeps the scales in one person's hand
meanings.advice: let it be even: give or receive without keeping the ledger
meanings.general: giving and receiving, help with a balance to it

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A young man leans on his hoe and looks at the coins grown on the bush he has been tending.

meanings.situation: effort in the ground, results not yet in
meanings.obstacle: impatience with something that only grows slowly
meanings.advice: assess it honestly, then either let it grow or pull it up
meanings.general: patience, assessment, waiting on what was planted

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A craftsman hammers one coin at his bench, seven finished ones hung up beside him.

meanings.situation: steady repeated work, one piece at a time
meanings.obstacle: grinding at the work to avoid the bigger question
meanings.advice: put the hours in; the skill is built by the repetition
meanings.general: practice, diligence, repetition that builds skill

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A woman stands alone in her own walled garden, a hooded falcon resting on her glove.

meanings.situation: something built alone and enjoyed alone
meanings.obstacle: independence that has quietly become a wall
meanings.advice: enjoy what you built, and let someone into the garden
meanings.general: self-sufficiency, earned comfort, your own ground

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: An old man sits with his dogs under an archway while a couple and a child pass by, coins all around them.

meanings.situation: established ground: family, or a long-term structure
meanings.obstacle: inherited structures that assume you will keep them going
meanings.advice: decide what you want to keep of what was handed to you
meanings.general: legacy, stability, what outlasts the person who built it

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A young figure holds a coin up in both hands and studies it, standing in a ploughed field.

meanings.situation: something new and practical being examined closely
meanings.obstacle: study that stays study and never becomes practice
meanings.advice: start small and expect to be bad at it first
meanings.general: a beginner's study, an offer to learn something practical

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: An armoured rider sits still on a heavy horse at the edge of a ploughed field, holding out a coin.

meanings.situation: progress happening slowly and dependably
meanings.obstacle: steadiness that has become standing still
meanings.advice: keep the plodding pace; it gets there if you don't stop
meanings.general: slow reliability, unglamorous steady progress

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A queen sits in a flowering garden looking down at the coin cradled in her lap, a rabbit at her feet.

meanings.situation: things being looked after competently and quietly
meanings.obstacle: carrying everyone's practical needs and your own last
meanings.advice: tend yourself with the competence you give everything else
meanings.general: practical care, resourcefulness, tending things well

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.imagery_line: A king sits among grapevines with a coin resting on his knee and a castle behind him.

meanings.situation: solid ground, built and maintained
meanings.obstacle: success defended so carefully it stopped being enjoyed
meanings.advice: use what you built; it exists to be spent, not guarded
meanings.general: material mastery, provision, ground that is established

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A hand grips an upright sword from a cloud, a crown and a wreath hanging on the blade.

meanings.situation: a clear idea or a plain truth arriving with force
meanings.obstacle: a truth that has to be said, and will cut when it is
meanings.advice: name it precisely; the clean statement is the whole move
meanings.general: clarity, the truth named, a decision that cuts through

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A blindfolded woman sits with two crossed swords held against her chest, the sea behind her.

meanings.situation: a decision held in balance, deliberately unlooked at
meanings.obstacle: an avoidance being maintained with real effort
meanings.advice: take the blindfold off before you decide anything
meanings.general: stalemate, refusal to look, a balance held blind

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.imagery_line: Three swords pass through a single heart under grey rain.

meanings.situation: a clean and painful piece of knowledge
meanings.obstacle: a hurt that keeps getting re-read
meanings.advice: let it hurt the honest amount, then stop rehearsing it
meanings.general: heartbreak, painful clarity, the words that hurt

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A knight lies still on a tomb with his hands together, three swords on the wall above him.

meanings.situation: a pause; recovery rather than progress
meanings.obstacle: rest that has quietly become hiding
meanings.advice: actually rest: stopping is the work right now
meanings.general: rest, retreat, deliberate stillness

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A man gathers up swords while two others walk away with their backs turned.

meanings.situation: a win that damaged something on the way
meanings.obstacle: needing to be right more than needing the outcome
meanings.advice: decide whether winning this is worth what it costs
meanings.general: conflict won badly, the cost of being right

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A ferryman poles a boat with a cloaked woman and child aboard, six swords standing in the hull.

meanings.situation: a move away from something rough, in progress
meanings.obstacle: leaving with everything still packed in the boat
meanings.advice: go, and accept that some of it comes with you for now
meanings.general: transition, moving to calmer water, carrying it along

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A man carries five swords away from a camp, glancing back at the two he has left behind.

meanings.situation: something being done quietly, around the edges
meanings.obstacle: a strategy that depends on not being fully honest
meanings.advice: do the direct version, or admit to yourself why you won't
meanings.general: evasion, half-truths, taking the indirect route

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A bound and blindfolded figure stands among eight swords set in the ground, with no fence between them.

meanings.situation: constraint that feels total and is not quite
meanings.obstacle: a cage with a gap in it that nobody has tested
meanings.advice: test one wall and find out which parts are real
meanings.general: feeling trapped, restriction that is mostly self-held

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.imagery_line: Someone sits up in bed with their face in their hands, nine swords hanging on the wall behind.

meanings.situation: worry running much hotter than the facts
meanings.obstacle: fear rehearsed in private and never said out loud
meanings.advice: say the worst of it out loud to one person; it shrinks
meanings.general: anxiety, sleepless dread, the mind at night

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A figure lies face down with ten swords in his back, the black sky breaking to gold at the horizon.

meanings.situation: something thoroughly finished, nothing left to defend
meanings.obstacle: an ending being dramatised instead of accepted
meanings.advice: call it over; the light is already at the edge
meanings.general: ending, the bottom, overkill

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A young figure holds a sword up while walking over rough ground, hair and clouds blown sideways.

meanings.situation: questions being asked, energy sharp and unfocused
meanings.obstacle: vigilance that reads everything as a threat
meanings.advice: stay curious, and ask directly instead of watching
meanings.general: watchfulness, curiosity, testing ideas out

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.imagery_line: An armoured rider charges at a full gallop with his sword raised into the wind.

meanings.situation: fast forceful movement, all in one direction
meanings.obstacle: speed that has outrun the reason for it
meanings.advice: charge if you mean it, but know what you are riding at
meanings.general: charge, urgency, argument at speed

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A queen sits with an upright sword in one hand and the other hand held out, clouds behind her.

meanings.situation: things being seen clearly, without comfort added
meanings.obstacle: a clarity that has hardened into distance
meanings.advice: say the true thing plainly, and stay warm while you say it
meanings.general: clear sight, honesty without padding, hard-won perspective

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.imagery_line: A king faces forward with an upright sword in his hand, clouds gathering behind the throne.

meanings.situation: a matter being decided on principle
meanings.obstacle: principle used to avoid the human part of it
meanings.advice: rule on it, then check the ruling against the people in it
meanings.general: judgment, principle, deciding by reason

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A hand holds out a sprouting branch from a cloud, loose leaves falling away from it.

meanings.situation: energy arriving, unformed but real
meanings.obstacle: an impulse that keeps not getting acted on
meanings.advice: act while it is hot; the spark does not keep
meanings.general: a spark, raw impulse, the start of wanting something

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A man on a castle wall holds a small globe and looks out to sea, one staff fixed beside him.

meanings.situation: standing at the edge of a decision to expand
meanings.obstacle: the world in hand and no move made toward it
meanings.advice: pick a direction and commit; the view has told you enough
meanings.general: planning, the wider view, deciding whether to go

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A figure stands on a cliff among three planted staffs, watching ships move out across the water.

meanings.situation: something sent out, the results still at sea
meanings.obstacle: waiting on returns that cannot be hurried
meanings.advice: keep looking out rather than back, and send the next one
meanings.general: the wait after launching, watching it go out

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.imagery_line: Four staffs hold up a flower garland while two figures raise bouquets beneath it.

meanings.situation: a milestone reached and worth marking
meanings.obstacle: stability that would be risked by wanting more
meanings.advice: mark it properly before moving to the next thing
meanings.general: arrival, celebration, ground that feels steady

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.imagery_line: Five young men swing staffs at each other, though nobody seems to be aiming.

meanings.situation: clashing energy, more noise than danger
meanings.obstacle: a conflict nobody is actually trying to win
meanings.advice: find out what the fight is really about, or leave it
meanings.general: friction, scrappy competition, noise

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A rider wearing a laurel crown moves through a crowd on foot, a wreath tied to his staff.

meanings.situation: something going well, and visibly
meanings.obstacle: needing the win to be witnessed before it counts
meanings.advice: take the credit plainly and keep riding
meanings.general: recognition, a win that others can see

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A man on higher ground holds off six staffs coming up at him, wearing two different boots.

meanings.situation: a position being held under steady pressure
meanings.obstacle: defending something you never decided was worth it
meanings.advice: hold the ground that is actually yours and drop the rest
meanings.general: defending your ground, holding a position

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.imagery_line: Eight staffs fly through clear air over open country with nothing in their way.

meanings.situation: fast movement, several things arriving together
meanings.obstacle: everything moving too fast to aim
meanings.advice: move now, while the way is still clear
meanings.general: speed, things landing at once, momentum

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A bandaged man leans on his staff and watches, eight more staffs standing behind him like a fence.

meanings.situation: still standing, tired, watching for the next hit
meanings.obstacle: vigilance built from old hits and applied to a quiet field
meanings.advice: keep going, and check whether the fence is still needed
meanings.general: resilience, guarded persistence, one more round

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A man carries ten staffs in a bundle, bent under them, the town not far ahead.

meanings.situation: a heavy load carried close to the destination
meanings.obstacle: carrying what could have been shared or put down
meanings.advice: put some of it down; you were never required to carry it all
meanings.general: burden, taking on too much, the last stretch

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A young figure stands in open country holding a staff planted in the ground and looks up at it.

meanings.situation: a fresh interest with real heat behind it
meanings.obstacle: enthusiasm that runs out before the second week
meanings.advice: chase the new thing, and give it longer than the excitement lasts
meanings.general: enthusiasm, a new want, restless beginnings

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.imagery_line: An armoured rider on a rearing horse carries a staff, moving fast across dry country.

meanings.situation: bold movement, more heat than plan
meanings.obstacle: impulsiveness that keeps costing the same way
meanings.advice: go hard at it, but pick the direction before you kick
meanings.general: boldness, charging at what you want, heat

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A queen sits facing outward with a staff in one hand and a sunflower in the other, a black cat at her feet.

meanings.situation: energy that other people gather around
meanings.obstacle: warmth spent outward while your own want goes unnamed
meanings.advice: say what you want as directly as you back other people
meanings.general: confidence, warmth, presence held steadily

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.imagery_line: A king leans forward on his throne with a staff in his hand and a small salamander at his feet.

meanings.situation: direction being set, and others following it
meanings.obstacle: vision that keeps outrunning the follow-through
meanings.advice: set the direction, then stay for the unglamorous middle
meanings.general: vision, leadership, the will to set a direction
